name: PAPEPO GDPR Scanner
author: PAPEPO

sections.description:
Many free cookie consent plugins only hide banners visually but fail to block background tracking scripts, leaving your visitors’ data exposed.

PAPEPO GDPR Scanner & Privacy Auditor is a powerful, lightweight diagnostic tool designed to reveal exactly what your website is loading behind the scenes. Using advanced browser-level performance monitoring, it detects third-party resources that may leak visitor IP addresses and compromise your GDPR compliance.

🚀 Key Features

  • Real-time Engine: Scans your live site for external connections (Google Fonts, YouTube, Facebook Pixel, Tracking Scripts).
  • Visual Dashboard: Get a clear ‘Privacy Health Score’ (A to F) based on detected vulnerabilities.
  • Professional PDF Reports: Generate clean, printable audit reports with one click—perfect for IT teams, clients, or legal reviews.
  • Competitor Testing: Keep your current cookie plugin active and run our scanner to see if it’s truly protecting your data or just creating an illusion of compliance.

🛡️ Upgrade to True Protection

If the scanner detects leaks, you can easily upgrade to ConsentBase Pro directly from the report to deploy our kernel-level interceptor and block unauthorized connections before they execute.

External Services

Transparency is our priority. This plugin relies on the following external links for premium upgrades and legal compliance:

  • ConsentBase Pro: The plugin contains promotional links directing users to https://papepo.uk to offer our premium consent management solution for fixing detected vulnerabilities.
  • Privacy Policy: https://papepo.uk/public/privacy-policy/
  • Terms of Service: https://papepo.uk/public/terms-of-service/

Note: The scanning engine itself runs entirely locally in your browser using the PerformanceObserver API. It does NOT send your scan data, visitor IPs, or website logs to our servers or any third parties.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the papepo-gdpr-scanner directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Tools > GDPR Scanner in your WordPress admin dashboard.
  4. Click “Start Real-time Scan” to begin your privacy audit.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin fix the privacy leaks automatically?

No. This is a purely diagnostic auditing tool. It acts as an inspector to identify vulnerabilities. To automatically block these tracking scripts and fix the leaks, we recommend upgrading to ConsentBase Pro.

Does this plugin slow down my website?

Not at all. The scanner only runs when you actively click the “Start Real-time Scan” button in the admin dashboard. It does not load any heavy scripts on your public-facing frontend.
